# Eulogy

> Track 1 animated film. Six chapters per life, one funeral, one question about who speaks. The committed 30-life screening uses deterministic generation.

## Screening and evidence

- [README.md](README.md) — Pitch, controls, runnable demo and criteria mapped to implementation.
- [docs/EVIDENCE.md](docs/EVIDENCE.md) — Measured outcomes, three archive excerpts, browser observations and service status.
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) — Role state, full system prompt, Monte Carlo loop, stores and contracts.
- [docs/DECISIONS.md](docs/DECISIONS.md) — Ten implementation decisions and their tradeoffs.
- [data/profiles/louis.json](data/profiles/louis.json) — The exact initial conditions and four relatives used for the screening.
- [data/runs/louis-demo.jsonl](data/runs/louis-demo.jsonl) — Thirty complete lives with per-chapter provenance.
- [data/runs/louis-demo.summary.json](data/runs/louis-demo.summary.json) — Role percentages, ending counts and two featured IDs.
- [docs/assets/ensemble-1000.json](docs/assets/ensemble-1000.json) — Reproducible 1,000-life counts and full-archive SHA-256.

## Cast and model

- [packages/shared/src/schemas.ts](packages/shared/src/schemas.ts) — Zod profile, event, funeral, run and summary contracts.
- [packages/shared/src/sample.ts](packages/shared/src/sample.ts) — Handwritten development fixtures.
- [packages/shared/src/rng.ts](packages/shared/src/rng.ts) — Seeded pseudorandom generator and bounds.
- [packages/sim/src/chapter.ts](packages/sim/src/chapter.ts) — Claude transport, system text, reply validation and Destiny veto.
- [packages/sim/src/simulate.ts](packages/sim/src/simulate.ts) — Single-life state transitions, deterministic fallback and ending classifier.
- [packages/sim/src/shocks.ts](packages/sim/src/shocks.ts) — Shock catalogue, weights and age sampling.
- [packages/sim/src/generate.ts](packages/sim/src/generate.ts) — Bounded scheduling, summary and JSONL output.
- [packages/sim/src/index.ts](packages/sim/src/index.ts) — Single-batch CLI and optional room and prior connections.
- [scripts/ensemble.ts](scripts/ensemble.ts) — Full thousand-life replay and digest.
- [packages/sim/src/chapter-contract.test.ts](packages/sim/src/chapter-contract.test.ts) — Boundary and retry examples.

- [apps/web/src/components/ChapelScene.tsx](apps/web/src/components/ChapelScene.tsx) — Architecture, Ready Player Me rigs, seated poses and speaker movement.

- [apps/web/api/simulate.ts](apps/web/api/simulate.ts) — Twelve-life generation and publication of a private batch.
- [apps/web/api/runs.ts](apps/web/api/runs.ts) — Cookie-bound replay.
- [apps/web/api/upload.ts](apps/web/api/upload.ts) — Photo validation and time-limited read access.
- [apps/web/api/portraits.ts](apps/web/api/portraits.ts) — Validated Runware orchestration.
- [vercel.json](vercel.json) — SPA rewrites and function time budgets.
- [.github/workflows/ci.yml](.github/workflows/ci.yml) — Required checks and regenerated mart comparison.
